events.text: Lanier was involved in assisting to move the capital from Corydon to Indianapolis.
events.subject: self
events.quote: assisting to move the capital from Corydon to Indianapolis in 1825

events.text: Lanier became president of the Bank of Kentucky.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became president of the Bank of Kentucky in 1833

events.text: The rail line connecting Madison and Indianapolis was finally finished.
events.subject: self

events.text: Lanier represented Indiana in a meeting with its European creditors.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The same year , Lanier represented Indiana in a meeting with its European creditors

events.text: His large mansion in Madison was completed.
events.subject: self

events.text: He was remarried to Margaret Mary McClure.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was remarried to Margaret Mary McClure in 1848

events.text: He began trading railroad shares in New York in a bank he started there with Richard Winslow called Winslow, Lanier & Co.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1849 , he began trading railroad shares in New York in a bank he started there in the same year with Richard Winslow called Winslow , Lanier & Co.

events.text: He moved out of the state to New York.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1851 , he moved out of the state to New York

events.text: The money he loaned the Indiana government was all repaid.
events.subject: self
